title: Throughput commit escrow and preempt safety net
author: Aisha Rahman
description: Context: Some tenants experienced abrupt preemptions during cluster reclamation windows which violated short-term throughput guarantees and caused cascading backpressure. Goal: introduce a tenant-scoped throughput escrow that tracks committed but unused throughput units and a soft-preempt safety net that consumes escrow credits before hard preemption. Approach: add a lightweight escrow ledger (decaying credits, epoched reconciliation), integrate with the preempt decision path to prefer consuming escrowed units and only escalate to hard preempt when escrow and soft-grace windows are exhausted, and expose new metrics for utilization and escrow reserves. Changes include a new EscrowAllocator in the dedicated controller, API hooks for reservation queries, and a controller-level 'soft-preempt' toggle for gradual rollout. Rollout plan: feature flag OFF by default; enable for 10% of dedicated pools for 7 days; monitor metrics (escrow_balance_pct, soft_preempt_fired, tenant_throughput_95th) and rollback if tail latency > baseline+20%. Migration: no DB migrations; controller state is ephemeral and reconstructs from recent lease events. Checklist: - [x] spec document (ENG-2102) - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] smoke test on staging - [x] telemetry dashboards and alerts. Notes: ties to SUP-1794 for customer incident; introduces new metric labels (tenant_id, pool_id) which may increase cardinality—telemetry team reviewed and approved sampling strategy. Backwards compatibility: none of the external APIs used by customers change; internal reservation semantics updated behind a flag. Links: design doc: internal.link/ENG-2102; incident: internal.link/SUP-1794; rollout runbook: internal.link/runbooks/throughput-escrow.

release_notes: Introduce tenant-scoped throughput escrow and soft-preempt safety net behind a feature flag. Improves graceful degradation during cluster reclamation and reduces hard preempts. Monitor escrow_balance_pct and soft_preempt_fired metrics during rollout.
notes: Feature guaranteed behind --feature-throughput-escrow; manual rollout via k8s/featureflags.yaml; telemetry sampling strategy added to limit cardinality.
